sourceConflictsAndExcludedCells.finding: The actual table movement phrase says opening thighs, while its direction column/prose give adduction. No conflicting hip phrase is adopted; the separate tibial-flexion and medial-tibial-insertion cells support the knee comparison.
The actual table movement phrase says thighs back together while its direction column and prose give abduction. The conflict is retained; single-leg pelvic stabilization remains unbound.
The actual table says opens thighs but its direction column and prose give adduction. The precise prose is used for the two pectineus comparisons.

The CNXML image description assigns zygomaticus major to lower-lip depression. The actual image names depressor labii inferioris there and gives zygomaticus major its own smiling/lateral-elevation row. The actual image, not the shifted description, is used.
The named facial-table row gives a lower-jaw target although the claim is mouth-angle depression. That claim remains unresolved.
The abdominal table labels trunk twisting supination. Only its named oblique movement/side-bending cells and prose are used; no supination term is copied to the app.
Away/toward-body wording is ambiguous across wrist rows. The named abduction/adduction target cells and paired muscles are compared, with no measured co-contraction protocol inferred.
The jaw table pairs posterior with protracts. Only its forward-jaw/opening/side-to-side movement wording is used; the inconsistent direction label is excluded.
